docs.content:
# Utilities Reference

The `src/utils/` directory contains the small helpers shared across the
codebase. This document is a quick reference for the load-bearing helpers
and is reviewed on every quarterly refactor.

## Format Helpers

The `formatDate` helper in `src/utils/format.ts` produces a human-friendly
date string from a Unix timestamp. It is the canonical date formatter and
is consumed by every UI surface that displays timestamps to end users.

Output format is `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm` in UTC. The formatter does not localise
output; localisation is the caller's responsibility. Callers that need a
different timezone wrap `formatDate` with their own offset application.

## String Helpers

The string helpers in `src/utils/strings.ts` cover trimming, casing, and
template substitution. None of these are async; they are all pure CPU
helpers and are safe to call from hot loops. The substitution helper
supports `{{name}}` placeholders only — no expression evaluation.

## Async Helpers

The async helpers in `src/utils/async.ts` cover retry-with-backoff and
parallel-with-concurrency-cap. The retry helper is the canonical retry
primitive for transient external calls; new code should not hand-roll
retries.

## Logging Helpers

The logging helpers in `src/utils/log.ts` standardise structured log
output. Every log call carries a request-scoped correlation id. The
helpers throw if the correlation id is not present; this is intentional
to surface missed instrumentation early.
